_comment: The extension's published identity, read by scripts/pack.mjs. firefoxId and firefoxUpdatesJsonUrl go into the Firefox manifest (the release workflow publishes updates.json there). chromePublicKey is optional: the Chrome Web Store item's public key (Developer Dashboard, Package, Public key); when set, the local build/chrome tree carries it as `key`, so an unpacked build has the store item's ID. The Web Store package never carries it.
